Package com.cognizant.emk.multiagent.domain.auth

package com.cognizant.emk.multiagent.domain.auth
Auth bounded context — domain layer.

Carries ApiKey, ClientId, the sealed Principal type (UserPrincipal | SystemPrincipal), and ApiKeyRepository. Populated by EPIC-04.

  • Class
    Description
    ApiKey
    Machine-to-machine API key aggregate (REQ-AUTH-007 / -012, design §4.1).
    ApiKeyNotFoundException
    Thrown when an admin operation references an unknown ClientId.
    ApiKeyRepository
    Domain repository port for the ApiKey aggregate (design §4.1).
    ClientId
    Public identifier of an API-key pair — what callers send in the X-Client-Id header (design §8.4).
    InvalidCredentialsException
    Generic authentication failure raised by the auth use cases and the JWT filter.
    Principal
    The authenticated principal of an incoming request (design §8.4 / §8.6).
    SystemPrincipal
    API-key-authenticated machine principal (design §8.4 / §8.6).
    UserPrincipal
    JWT-authenticated end-user principal.
